messages.text: Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T

Heads up on that one: the H15 Dual isn't buyable yet — it's $999 and the drop date hasn't been announced. Ships mid-November once it opens.

For a first miner that you can actually order today, I'd point you at the Harlo B30 ($899, ~30 TH/s) or the Magic Miner 40T ($799) — both Bitcoin only, both pre-sale.

Is the Dogecoin side a must-have for you, or mainly Bitcoin?

context.pop: Would the + Dogecoin be your first miner?
